name: The Ritz Carlton Perth
positioning: Riverfront hotel on Elizabeth Quay in Perth, listed by Ritz-Carlton as The Ritz-Carlton, Perth
best_for: Travelers who want a Swan River base in Perth with a spa and a pool
Food-focused guests drawn to open-fire cooking and a rooftop bar
Families interested in the Ritz Kids program

facts.text: The hotel sits on Elizabeth Quay, where the Swan River meets the city of Perth.
The spa has four treatment rooms, including a couple’s spa suite.
Every room has a bathroom with a dual vanity and a standalone tub.
The Ritz-Carlton Suite has a master bedroom, private study, balcony, and a separate living and dining room with a butler’s kitchen.
The Ritz-Carlton Club offers a dedicated concierge and a private Club Lounge.
Ritz Kids gives young guests a personalised check-in and an Adventurer Passport to explore the hotel.
The hotel offers a full-day Margaret River journey with winery tastings and a seasonal lunch.

highlights.text: Hearth Restaurant cooks with open fire and celebrates local producers from Western Australia to the Great Southern regions.
Songbird is the hotel’s rooftop bar, with panoramic Swan River views.
The heated outdoor infinity pool looks out over the Swan River and city skyline.
The spa works with the skincare brands LaGaia Unedited and Biologique Recherche on its treatments.

considerations.text: The hotel does not provide shuttle service.
Club access requires an upgraded booking, and Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide it for free.
Pets are not allowed at the hotel.
